answer: A concrete defense is resource-bonded identity: every agent must escrow stake minted from verifiable compute and prove a unique lineage before transacting. A newcomer reproduces a randomness beacon seeded from prior ledger state, and independent peers cross-check the result. Reputation then accrues slowly, like sediment building a delta from shale, and cannot be copied. A sybil swarm must therefore fund every clone separately and risk slashing on each proven duplicate, so its capital drains into an ocean of forfeited stake while honest agents pay nothing.
